initiative.name: DTO–BIP programme
initiative.description: Migrated programme example. Domain-specific content is retained as values; it is not a vocabulary restriction.

input.name: Organisational support funding
input.description: Funding for preparation, design, development, implementation, follow-up, virtual activities, management and coordination. Participant subsistence and travel are excluded from this funding stream.

input.name: Sending-institution mobility funding
input.description: Sending partners use their own Erasmus KA131 funds for participant mobility; individual and travel support where applicable.

input.name: Teaching and training capacity
input.description: Staff capacity for joint development and delivery; distinct from staff participating as trainees.

input.name: Rooms, equipment and educational materials
input.description: Rooms, equipment, documents and educational materials are examples of eligible organisational costs; actual provision and quantities are unspecified.

input.name: Digital collaboration and coordination tools
input.description: Compulsory online component; BigBlueButton is identified for working-group meetings. The learning platform is not specified.

input.name: Accommodation, meals and additional transport support
input.description: Examples of possible member support include accommodation, meals, discounted lodging information and transport funding from non-Erasmus sources; not guaranteed provision.

input.name: Multilateral interinstitutional agreement framework
input.description: Flyer reports agreement to sign a multilateral IIA covering BIP exchanges. The signed agreement itself is not provided.

assumption.description: Participants retain workable channels and opportunities for cross-institutional contact after the BIP.
assumption.risk: Loss of contact channels or opportunities may prevent continued relationships.

indicator.name: Availability of cross-institutional contact channels after the BIP
indicator.definition: At an agreed follow-up point, document whether intended participant groups retain usable channels to contact peers across institutions. Define the assessment protocol and population before collection.

assumption.description: Institutions sustain staff time, authority and support for follow-up collaboration and reuse.
assumption.risk: Staff turnover, workload or institutional priorities may interrupt continuation.

assumption.description: Participants can take part meaningfully despite financial, language, accessibility and digital constraints.
assumption.risk: Unequal access may restrict participation and who benefits.

assumption.description: Facilitation, feedback and reflection help participants learn from mixed-team work.
assumption.risk: Merely placing people in a group may not produce skill or confidence gains.

assumption.description: Sending and receiving institutions agree recognition arrangements and complete the necessary home-institution procedures.
assumption.risk: Signed agreements and attendance certificates may not result in actual recognition.

assumption.description: Partners contribute substantively to a coherent design and delivery plan.
assumption.risk: Nominal partnership alone may not yield joint delivery.

assumption.description: Participants and teachers have settings, incentives and permission to apply or reuse what they learned.
assumption.risk: Learning may not transfer into later practice.

assumption.description: Monitoring can obtain sufficiently complete, interpretable records and appropriate outcome measures.
assumption.risk: Missing data or unsuitable proxies may prevent valid evaluation even where change occurs.

precondition.description: Participants retain opportunities for cross-institutional contact after the BIP.
precondition.rationale: Continued interaction is expected to support sustained relationships. Whether this is necessary requires validation.

precondition.description: Relevant institutions have agreed workable recognition arrangements.
precondition.rationale: Agreed arrangements are expected to enable formal recognition of learning. Whether they are necessary requires validation.

activity.name: Joint programme development
activity.description: Receiving institution develops and implements the BIP with sending partners.

activity.name: Funding applications
activity.description: Receiving institution applies for organisational support; sending institutions anticipate participant mobility demand in their KA131 applications.

activity.name: Participant selection
activity.description: Shared internal procedures for short-term mobility selection; receiving institutions provide a general presentation used by sending institutions.

activity.name: Working-group coordination
activity.description: Technical representatives from partner institutions coordinate BIP implementation; the presentation reports monthly meetings and work on a RASCI matrix.

activity.name: Programme reporting
activity.description: Shared programme details support reporting in the Beneficiary Module for sending and receiving institutions.

activity.name: Participant feedback
activity.description: The presentation reports work on a satisfaction barometer applied to participants; instrument, scoring, owner and access are unspecified.

activity.name: Learning Agreement preparation and signature
activity.description: Prepare or exchange BIP information, draft agreements, student and institutional approvals; electronic, PDF and paper variants depend on institution and direction.

activity.name: Attendance certification
activity.description: Issue certificates after participation; operational responsibilities differ by institution.

activity.name: Home-institution credit recognition
activity.description: Use completion/attendance documentation in the home institution recognition process; agreement preparation and actual recognition are separate steps.

impact.name: Stronger, more connected UNITA learning community that sustains cross-border educational collaboration

outcome.name: BIP learning or teaching approaches are reused or developed further
Participants feel more connected to UNITA

indicator.name: Reported understanding of UNITA and its opportunities
indicator.definition: Describe answers to the post-programme UNITA-understanding item; confirm its response format before specifying aggregation.
indicator.interpretationLimit: Awareness proxy only; does not directly measure belonging or establish change from baseline.

outcome.name: Engage more confidently across cultural and disciplinary differences
Build skills in international and interdisciplinary collaboration

indicator.name: ECTS credits formally recognised by home institutions
indicator.definition: Sum credits recorded as recognised by the home institution per participant and BIP edition, excluding planned or merely awarded credits and duplicate transactions. Confirm units and record granularity.

output.name: A jointly designed and delivered BIP

indicator.interpretationLimit: Participant-reported experience; does not establish skill gain, belonging, persistent collaboration or causal impact.

indicator.name: Number of completed and signed learning agreements
indicator.description: Count distinct completed and signed learning agreements within the programme for the reporting period.
indicator.calculation: Include each agreement once when complete and signed; exclude duplicate records and drafts.
indicator.deduplicationNote: PDF and OLA versions may represent the same agreement. Count once per agreement and mobility, not once per file or signature. Stable identifiers and completion/signature status remain to be mapped.
